email-verification.subject: Verify your Perigee email
email-verification.preheader: Your email verification code is ready. It expires in 5 minutes.
email-verification.intro: Verify your email address to finish setting up your Perigee account. Enter this code on the verification screen:
email-verification.safety: If you did not create a Perigee account, you can ignore this email.

password-reset.subject: Reset your Perigee password
password-reset.preheader: Use your reset code to choose a new password. It expires in 5 minutes.
password-reset.intro: We received a request to reset your Perigee password. Enter this code on the password reset screen to continue:
password-reset.safety: If you did not request a password reset, ignore this email. Your password has not changed.

order-placed.subject: Order placed | Perigee {{orderNumber}}
order-placed.preheader: Your order has been placed. We have saved the details and will email you when a vendor updates their part of your order.
order-placed.title: Your order is in.
order-placed.intro: Your order has been placed. We have saved the details and will email you when a vendor updates their part of your order.
order-placed.next: You can review your items and the latest status from your order page.

order-cancelled.subject: Order cancelled | Perigee {{orderNumber}}
order-cancelled.preheader: Your order has been cancelled. The pending and processing parts of this order will no longer be fulfilled.
order-cancelled.title: Your order was cancelled.
order-cancelled.intro: Your order has been cancelled. The pending and processing parts of this order will no longer be fulfilled.
order-cancelled.next: Open your order to review the cancellation. If you need help, reply to this email.

order-processing.subject: Order update: processing | Perigee {{orderNumber}}
order-processing.preheader: A vendor has started processing their part of your order.
order-processing.title: Things are moving.
order-processing.intro: A vendor has started processing their part of your order.
order-processing.next: This update applies to one vendor's part. Open your order to see the status of every item.

order-completed.subject: Order update: part completed | Perigee {{orderNumber}}
order-completed.preheader: A vendor has completed their part of your order.
order-completed.title: One part is complete.
order-completed.intro: A vendor has completed their part of your order.
order-completed.next: Other parts of your order may still be in progress. Open your order to check each item.

order-vendor-cancelled.subject: Order update: part cancelled | Perigee {{orderNumber}}
order-vendor-cancelled.preheader: A vendor has cancelled their part of your order.
order-vendor-cancelled.title: A change to your order.
order-vendor-cancelled.intro: A vendor has cancelled their part of your order.
order-vendor-cancelled.next: Other parts of your order may continue. Open your order to see which items were affected, or reply to this email for help.
